title: About myself
hook: How many relatives can you name in English in one minute?

Name your uncles, aunts and cousins.
Say when the family get together.
Finish with what you like about your family.

uncle — the brother of your mother or father
cousin — the child of your aunt or uncle
grandparent — a parent of one’s mother or father
grandson / granddaughter — a son / daughter of your child
get together — to come together, to gather
nearby — near, close
formulas: I have got + noun — to say what you have
My name is ... and I am from ...
We usually + verb — a repeated action

title: Direct and indirect speech
